params.message:
Restructure the site into landing, Infrastructure, Services, How we work, News and insights

The landing page keeps one message and points onward. Its gateway story,
the regulated-blockchain features, the ISBE layers and the four
infrastructure services move to a new Infrastructure page, which replaces
Networks (networks.html now forwards there). Services is rebuilt around
verification, validation and volition, each with an example. How we work
follows the setup-plus-monthly pricing logic of the service description.
The blog becomes News and insights and takes the FAQ. A self-assessment
page with sliders ends in a request for a free 30-minute assessment,
sent by the visitor's own e-mail.

Moved copy that claimed a legal presumption today now says it applies
once ISBE holds qualified ledger status.
